{{Game-Tabs|pdth=Achievements|pd2=Achievements (Payday 2)|pd3=Achievements (Payday 3)|raid=Achievements (RAID: World War II)}}'''Achievements''', also known as '''Trophies''', are optional goals introduced to reward skillful play, encourage varied play-styles, or simply track progress through the game. They are distinct from the Safe House [[Safe House#Trophies|Trophy]] system, although some goals are shared between the two.

New players should be aware that most achievements are purely superficial, only serving as a form of bragging rights and/or proof of one achieving certain impressive feats. Some (especially those included within a DLC), however, will reward the player with a [[Masks (Payday 2)|mask]] (usually bundled with a [[Patterns|pattern]] and a [[Materials|material]]); others may give weapon modifications. The simplest way to find these achievements is to search the text on this page (Ctrl+F on windows, Command+F for MacOS) for the word "unlock". To find achievements that unlock weapon modifications, instead use the phrase "for the".

: '''Note:''' {{color|negative|''Achievements on the {{color|value|Playstation 4}} and {{color|value|Xbox One}} versions of ''PAYDAY 2'' do '''not''' award mods, masks, etc...''}}
Starting with the [[#Halloween Event 2013|2013 Halloween Event]], temporary "teaser" achievements are added to achievement pages prior to an update that contains new achievements. The teasers are removed when the new achievements are live.

Introduced in [[PC update history (Payday 2)#Update #171|Update #171]] were '''achievement milestones''', which are reached by unlocking certain numbers of achievements, with more milestones added as achievements are added to the game. All achievement milestones grant [[continental coins]], with some also giving cosmetic rewards.

|-|Trivia=
* '''No One Cared Who I Was...''' is a part of a quote by [[wikipedia:Bane (comics)|Bane]] from ''[[wikipedia:The Dark Knight Rises|The Dark Knight Rises]]''.
** The conditions required for completing the achievement are a reference to the second part of the quote:"...until I put on the mask."
** The achievement's icon was also Overkill producer [http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197971723118 Almir's] Steam avatar for a long time.
* '''Yeah He's a Gold Digger''' is a reference to [[wikipedia:Kanye West|Kanye West]]'s song "[[wikipedia:Gold Digger (Kanye West song)|Gold Digger]]".
* '''Fish A.I.''' is a joke about [[wikipedia:Infinity Ward|Infinity Ward]], who showcased their fish A.I. in ''[[wikipedia:Call of Duty: Ghosts|Call of Duty: Ghosts]]'' as a big achievement.
**The description of the achievement is also a reference to the joke, due to the fish AI in ''Ghosts'' simply moves away when the player moves near.
* '''Lord of War''' is a reference to the [[wikipedia:Lord of War|film of the same name]], which is about an illegal arms dealer.
* '''You Shall Not Pass!''' is a quote by [[wikipedia:Gandalf|Gandalf]] in ''[[wikipedia:The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring|The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring]]'' film.
* '''Man of Iron''' is a reference to the Marvel Comic character [[wikipedia:Iron Man|Iron Man]].
** Additionally, it could be a reference to the DC Comic character [[wikipedia:Superman|Superman]], who is frequently called "Man of Steel".
* '''Smooth Criminal''' is a reference to the [[wikipedia:Michael Jackson|Michael Jackson]] [[wikipedia:Smooth Criminal|song of the same name]].
* '''They See Me Baggin', They Hatin''' is a reference to the song "[[wikipedia:Ridin' (Chamillionaire song)|Ridin']]" by [[wikipedia:Chamillionaire|Chamillionaire]].
* An '''F in Chemistry''' is the lowest possible grade one may receive in American and British school systems, alluding to the crew's failure to add the correct ingredient and causing the lab to explode.
* '''Caribbean Pirate''' is a reference to the Disney movie franchise ''[[wikipedia:Pirates of the Caribbean (film series)|Pirates of the Caribbean]]''.
* '''Doctor Fantastic''' is likely a reference to the Marvel character Dr. Reed Richards, a.k.a. [[wikipedia:Mister Fantastic|Mister Fantastic]] of the [[wikipedia:Fantastic Four|Fantastic Four]]. He is a doctorate and a scientist who invents many high-tech devices, similar to the fusion engine stolen in [[Big Oil]].
* '''Diamonds are Forever''' is a reference to the [[wikipedia:James Bond|James Bond]] [[wikipedia:Diamonds Are Forever (novel)|novel]] and [[wikipedia:Diamonds Are Forever (film)|film]] of the same name.
* '''Shoot the Glass!''' is a likely reference to the film ''[[wikipedia:Die Hard|Die Hard]]''. The antagonist Hans Gruber orders his henchman to shoot out glass windows when he discovers that protagonist [[wikipedia:John McClane|John McClane]] is barefoot.
* '''The First Line''' is likely a reference to the first forward line in the game of [[wikipedia:Ice hockey|Ice hockey]].
* '''Tip the Scales''' is still possible to do even if players have overlevelled and cannot enter the old [[Laundromat Safe House]]. By upgrading [[Safe House#Rooms|John Wick's Shooting Range]] to level 3, the Lady Justice statue can be found in the Kill Room.
* The '''Armed to the Teeth''' achievement's icon depicts a [[Crosskill]] equipped with the [[Punisher Compensator]], Tactical Pistol Light, and [[12rnd Mag.]] mods.
* The '''Fully Loaded''' achievement's icon depicts, from left to right, top to bottom: The [[Crosskill]], [[Deagle]], [[Bernetti 9]], [[CMP]], [[Bronco .44 (Payday 2)|Bronco .44]] with the Pocket Surprise Barrel, [[Chimano 88]], [[Krinkov]] without a stock, and [[Locomotive 12G (Payday 2)|Locomotive 12G]].
* The '''Weapon Collector''' achievement's icon depicts, from left to right, top to bottom: The [[Crosskill]], [[Deagle]], [[Chimano 88]], [[Krinkov]] without a stock, [[Bernetti 9]], [[CMP]], [[Mark 10]], [[Bronco .44 (Payday 2)|Bronco .44]] with the Pocket Surprise Barrel, [[STRYK 18c]] with the [[Extended Mag (STRYK 18c)|Extended Mag]], [[Kobus 90]], [[Para]] with the Shorter Than Short Stock, [[UAR]], [[M308 (Payday 2)|M308]], [[Locomotive 12G (Payday 2)|Locomotive 12G]], and [[JP36]].
|-|Tips=
{{Achievement|Guessing Game|jpg|On day 2 of the [[Firestarter]] job, complete the heist in stealth without hacking the computer.}}
Play on Normal difficulty so that there are only three to four boxes to choose from, as opposed to four to five. Because the two correct wires are randomized, the probability of correctly guessing which two wires to cut is ~33.3% if there are three boxes, and ~16.7% if there are four.

{{Achievement|They See Me Baggin', They Hatin'|jpg|On the [[Garage Escape|Garage escape]], get away with 8 bags.}}
Possibly the best place to do this would be in the [[Rats]] job. The [[Transporter]] skill is helpful for moving bags.

On Day 1, cook at least six bags of meth. Meth bags are lighter than money bags, so cooking extra meth would make the escape somewhat easier, but a lot of time is given for an escape with eight bags anyway. If you encounter the Garage escape on Day 1, then restart the heist because it cannot be encountered on Day 2, making the achievement impossible.

On Day 2, make the trade. If you traded in at least six bags of meth, then there will be three extra money bags in the room with the intel. Grab enough money bags so that you will end up with at least eight loot bags total after you steal back the meth.

If you do not encounter the Garage escape on Day 2, then restart the heist. Otherwise, bring a saw or shaped charges if possible to open doors faster. Once the escape starts, throw at least eight of the bags onto the level above, towards the corner with the staircase that leads to the surface (4 or 5 o'clock when you spawn). Run to the bags, open the door to the nearby staircase and the door at the top of the staircase, and transport the bags to the escape van.
</tabber>

|-|Trivia=
* The achievement '''I Am the One Who Knocks''' is a ''{{w|Breaking Bad}}'' reference, being a quote from protagonist {{w|Walter White (Breaking Bad)|Walter White}}. The achievement '''Full Measure''' is also a reference to the show, as there is an [[w:c:breakingbad:Full Measure|episode with the same name]] and the supporting character [[w:c:breakingbad:Mike Ehrmantraut|Mike Ehrmantraut]] has a "No more half measures" speech which has become quite popular among the fan base.
* '''From Russia With Love''' is a reference to the {{w|James Bond}} {{w|From Russia, with Love (novel)|novel}} and {{w|From Russia, with Love (film)|film}} of the same name.
* '''It’s Alive! IT’S ALIVE!''' is a reference to a quote from {{w|Mary Shelley}}'s {{w|Frankenstein}} novel.
* '''Pump-Action''' is a pun on ''pump''kins and pump-action shotguns.
* '''No One Can Hear You Scream''' is a reference to the tagline of the 1979 film ''{{w|Alien (film)|Alien}}''.
* '''The Pumpkin King Made Me Do It!''' is likely a reference to {{w|Golden Earring|Golden Earring's}} song "{{w|Cut (Golden Earring album)|The Devil Made Me Do It}}". It may also reference the film ''{{w|The Nightmare Before Christmas}}'', as Halloween Town is ruled over by the Pumpkin King.
* '''Gilliam's Sweet Little Baby''' refers to ''{{w|Brazil (1985 film)|Brazil}}'', the film the achievement's mask is based on, being directed by {{w|Terry Gilliam}}.
</tabber>

|-|Tips=
{{Achievement|400 Bucks|png|I may be homeless, but at least I have a sick knife.<br>''{{color|negative|Tie or kill a specific homeless civilian in [[Aftershock]] and take his knife.}}''}}[[File:Knifeciv.jpg|50px|thumb|right]]
The knife will always be on a hobo that wears a blue hood. The civilian will always run to escape the map, meaning players will have to be quick to tie him down or shoot him.

{{Achievement|Bunnyhopping|png|Jump {{color|value|100}} times within {{color|value|30}} seconds. Unlocks the [[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|No Me Gusta]] mask.}}
The achievement can easily be obtained by simply mashing the jump button while standing in a doorway.

{{Achievement|I Never Asked For This|png|Don't jump a single time during an entire heist. Unlocks the [[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Rageface]] mask.}}
This can be accomplished on most maps even in solo, meaning earning this achievement is a simple matter of avoiding jump-requiring shortcuts or ignoring muscle memory if nothing else. Also note that falling off of elevated surfaces does not invalidate the achievement.

Currently, the only map that absolutely requires at least one jump to complete thus impossible to obtain the achievement on is [[Undercover (Payday 2)|Undercover]], where players have to jump to escape to the helicopter.

{{Achievement|Jump! Jump! Jump!|png|Finish a heist without it ever going more than {{color|value|4}} seconds between you jumping. Unlocks the [[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Dawg]] mask.}}
The only heists that do not require interactions equal to or longer than 4 seconds are [[Mallcrasher]], [[Santa's Workshop]], [[White Xmas]], and [[Jewelry Store]] on lower difficulties, meaning one can feasibly solo these heists and get the achievement, the former two provided that the player mask up and jump immediately.

Obviously, entering [[Police Custody#Bleedout|bleedout]] would void the achievement unless revived with [[Inspire]] aced almost immediately.
|-|Trivia=
*'''400 Bucks''' is a reference to [https://facepunch.com/showthread.php?t=1489016&p=48924662&viewfull=1#post48924662 one of the level designers who spent $400 USD on a knife] in ''{{w|Counter-Strike: Global Offensive}}''.
*'''Original Heisters''' is the first achievement to require the specific usage of certain characters, in this case the four original crew members ([[Dallas]], [[Chains]], [[Wolf]], [[Hoxton]]) from the first game.
*The '''OVERDRILL''' achievement's description references how most heist-related [[achievements]] in ''[[PAYDAY: The Heist]]'' would state "To complete this challenge, you have to have played the heist from the start." at the end of the achievement description, for the [[Challenges|challenge]] would not be considered completed if one joined a game mid-progress, and the achievement would not be awarded.
*The assembled title of [[First World Bank (Payday 2)|PAYDAY 2 First World Bank's]] teaser achievements forms a part of one of the [[Minor characters#Bank manager|Bank Manager's]] most memorable quotes from the original heist (''"...he was messing around in the server room..."'').
*'''But How?''' is an [[Slaughterhouse/Walkthrough#Unique achievements|achievement]] from the first game.
*'''I Never Asked For This''' is a likely reference to ''{{w|Deus Ex: Human Revolution}}'' where it is a memorable quote from the game's protagonist [[w:c:deusex:Adam Jensen|Adam Jensen]] when asked for his opinions on the transhuman augmentations he received.
</tabber>

The rings only spawn in the buildings and have 31 (of which 30 known) spawn locations. For their exact locations, consult [http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=670085047 this guide].
|-|Trivia=
*'''Saint Francis''' is apparently a mission given by [[John Wick]], with most of [[Bain]]'s lines regarding the achievement referencing John Wick. Wick, from Bain's lines, wants the two punks required for the achievement to be brought to the [[Safe House]] so he can torture them, on the grounds of them having abused a dog, evidenced by the achievement icon and its [[Side Jobs#Daily Side Jobs|Side Job]] description.
**If the punks are killed mid-heist, Bain will say that Wick will be disappointed that he couldn't take care of them himself, bizarrely even if John Wick is the one who killed them.
**Even though it's heavily implied that John Wick will torture and kill them after the heist and most if not all of the player characters and Bain show disgust for them, killing the two at the bank will impose the usual cleaner penalty.
*'''High Times''' is a [[wikipedia:High Times|magazine devoted to the publication of cannabis]]. It's also a pun on "high tides".
*'''Mellon''' is a reference to ''[[wikipedia:The Lord of the Rings|The Lord of the Rings]]'', the rings based on the [[wikipedia:Rings of Power|Rings of Power]]. Without the [[Cleaner]] skill aced, they're worth $1,954, the year ''The Lord of the Rings'' came out, and having to acquire 9 rings is a reference to how 9 of the Rings of Power were intended for man. On the rings are [[wikipedia:Elvish languages (Middle-earth)|Elvish]] inscriptions reading "One gang to rule them all in the hunt for riches and glory," referencing the inscription on the [[wikipedia:One Ring|One Ring]], "One ring to rule them all, one ring to find them, one ring to bring them all and in the darkness bind them." Additionally, "mellon" is the Elvish word for "friend", and the ring assets in the files are named "material_onering".
</tabber>

|-|Tips=
The trophies only spawn once per heist, necessitating playing them multiple times to unlock their achievements. However, they are counted towards the achievements immediately, so the players can simply find the heist's trophy, restart, and repeat.

The trophies spawn in several different locations, marked in [http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1158889307 this guide]. Notably, one of the Bullet Trophy spawns in [[Jewelry Store]] is on the vantage point, so unless the player(s) owns the [[Gage Sniper Pack]] and purchases the vantage point asset every time, more than 5 restarts may be necessary for the achievement.
</tabber>
